mapper.select: SELECT MIN(CAST(id AS BIGINT)) AS minId, MAX(CAST(id AS BIGINT)) AS maxId FROM fact_sales_day

SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sales AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS totalSales, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(gross AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS totalGross, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT product_no) AS INT) AS totalSku, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sales > 0 THEN product_no ELSE NULL END) AS INT) AS activeSku FROM fact_sales_day

SELECT sale_date AS saleDate, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(sales AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS totalSales, ISNULL(SUM(CAST(gross AS DECIMAL(20, 6))), 0) AS totalGross FROM fact_sales_day
GROUP BY sale_date ORDER BY sale_date ASC
